metadata.purpose: Preliminary validation of the Liquid Brine Index (LBI) against its actual target — large standing brine bodies — as distinct from diffuse produced-water spills.

classes.standing_brine: Documented persistent/standing hypersaline brine water (lakes, ponds, blowout pools).
classes.freshwater_control: Nominal regional fresh or brackish reservoir controls; scene footprints and chemistry still require verification.
classes.excluded_control: Archived off-lake point retained for provenance; do not score as an open-water control.
classes.note: Small positive N; Lake Boehmer is the app's stated LBI calibration site (circular) and is flagged. Caliche negatives come from execution/background_raw.csv (n=150).
